# Oscar Health, Inc. 2026 Third Quarter Earnings Conference Call


October 12, 2026 8:01am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_cf0e385e2d185942c72c9d928c46f52a/hioscar/news/2026-10-12_Oscar_Health_Inc_2026_Third_Quarter_Earnings_226.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Oscar Health, Inc. (NYSE: OSCR), a leading consumer healthcare company, will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Thursday, November 5, 2026.


Management will review these results in a conference call beginning at 8:00 AM (ET). A live audio webcast will be available online[here](https://event.on24.com/wcc/r/5526758/93DC08C5362AA6E6B2B44FC30E351B00) .


A replay of the call will be available via webcast on Oscar Health’s investor relations website ([ir.oscarhealth.com](http://ir.oscarhealth.com/) ) shortly after the completion of the call and will remain available for a period of 90 days.


**About Oscar Health** Oscar Health, Inc. (NYSE: OSCR) is a leading consumer health company that gives people power over their healthcare. Oscar Health serves millions of consumers, employers, brokers, and partners through[Oscar Insurance](https://www.hioscar.com/) ,[Lucie Health Marketplace](http://luciehealth.com/) , and[Trove Group](https://trovegroup.com/) . Together these businesses deliver exceptional lifestyle products and technology platforms that make healthcare easy to choose, use, and experience. Learn more at[OscarHealth.com](http://oscarhealth.com/) .
